scope: Desktop Web 1024 and 1440 CSS pixels; synthetic API separate from designated PostgreSQL evidence

checks.claim: Unknown policy values stay empty and require explicit publication
checks.controls: policy fields, matrix toggle and channel cells, publication and acknowledgment

checks.claim: A lost write response retains the original command
checks.controls: save, recover original, retry original, stop waiting
checks.evidence: same command identity and visible recovery

checks.claim: Current bindings are checked without enabling demo or external channels
checks.controls: load bindings, choose, check, valid-until, internal-use checkbox, save/discard
checks.states: partial channel failure, verified choice, dirty edit, saved reference
checks.evidence: browser actions; backend live role and binding checks separately

checks.claim: Read and navigation controls preserve scope and unsaved work
checks.controls: refresh, stop read, list selector, source replan, navigation
checks.evidence: normal input plus late-response unit tests

checks.claim: Owner publishes only a saved preference revision
checks.controls: read publication, acknowledge, publish, withdraw, original-command recovery
checks.evidence: browser flow and backend source-fingerprint checks

checks.claim: Desktop content is readable without page-level horizontal clipping
checks.controls: all visible labels, table region and focus
checks.states: initial and dense matrix at both widths

exploratory: Lose the first write response and recover without changing request identity
Fail one channel lookup while retaining the other channel
Revoke internal permission while a read is in flight
excluded: Unimplemented dispatch/dead-letter controls tracked as remaining N01 work
